Cookie Policy
1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, provide functionality, and collect analytical information.

Cookies can be "persistent" (remain on your device until you delete them or they expire) or "session" cookies (deleted when you close your browser). First-party cookies are set by Copygen; third-party cookies are set by our partners and service providers.
2. How Copygen Uses Cookies
We use cookies and similar technologies (such as local storage and session storage) for the following purposes:
Authentication: To keep you logged in and protect your account
Security: To detect and prevent fraudulent activity and secure payment sessions
Analytics: To understand how users navigate our platform so we can improve it
Preferences: To remember your settings across visits
3. Cookies We Use
Authentication cookies: sb-auth-token, Firebase session
Analytics cookies: Google Analytics _ga, _gid
Functional cookies: copygen_theme, copygen_tour_seen
Payment security cookies: Dodo Payments
4. Managing Your Cookie Preferences
You have several options to control or limit how we and our partners use cookies:

Most browsers allow you to manage cookies through their settings. You can set your browser to refuse cookies or delete specific cookies. Note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of Copygen.
You can opt out of Google Analytics tracking by installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on, available at tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout
Some browsers offer a "Do Not Track" (DNT) setting. When DNT is enabled, we limit analytics tracking to session-only data. Strictly necessary cookies remain active regardless of DNT settings.
5. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, law, or our data practices. When we do, we will update the "Last Updated" date above. Material changes will be communicated via email or a notice on our website.
